mustFixFindings.summary: Regression introduced by the repair: ensureDemoFixture creates the demo household via repos.households.create() (line 146) which assigns a generated id, but every subsequent fixture record (memberships, members, tasks, entries, todos) and signIn/loadHouseholds still reference DEMO_HOUSEHOLD_ID 'h-core'. loadHouseholds resolves getById('h-core') → null, so the root Groups screen shows 'Aucun groupe' after demo sign-in and the demo group is unreachable. Empirically confirmed via jest test mirroring the exact fixture + loadHouseholds logic (loaded.length = 0, expected 1). Additionally reposReady (line 73) is set but never consumed — a sign-in before repository init completes skips the fixture permanently. In the SQLite path, demo user is also created via create() with generated id so 'demo-user-alex' never exists and duplicate user rows accumulate on each sign-in.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Keep the demo fixture internally consistent: seed/create the demo household and demo user under the canonical ids (DEMO_HOUSEHOLD_ID 'h-core', 'demo-user-alex') or use the id returned by create() consistently for all subsequent records and currentHouseholdId. Consume reposReady or retry the fixture once repos are initialized so an early sign-in cannot permanently skip it.

mustFixFindings.summary: The required fix for the SQLite wiring finding explicitly demands 'repository tests cover the SQLite-backed repositories', but the candidate adds no such tests. mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Add tests covering SQLite-backed repositories (CRUD round-trips against mocked expo-sqlite driver or the factory's fallback selection), verifying data written through the repositories can be read back and that the in-memory fallback is selected in the test environment.
